Taa Seen. Yeh Quran aur raushan kitaab ki aayatein hain
Yeh saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye hidaayat aur bashaarat hain
Jo namaaz qaaim karte hain, zakaat ada karte hain aur aakhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain
Beshak jo log aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain hum ne un ke aamaal ko un ke liye aaraasta kar diya hai aur woh unhi aamaal mein bhatak rahe hain
Unhi logon ke liye badtareen azaab hai, aur yeh aakhirat mein khasaare waale hain
Aur aap ko yeh Quran Khuda-e-Aleem o Hakeem ki taraf se ata kiya ja raha hai
Us waqt ko yaad karo jab Moosa ne apne ahl se kaha tha ke main ne ek aag dekhi hai, aur anqareeb main us se raaste ki khabar laaoonga ya aag hi ka koi angaara le aaoonga ke tum taap sako

Us ke baad jab aag ke paas aaye to aawaaz aayi ke ba-barakat hai woh Khuda jo aag ke andar aur us ke atraaf mein apna jalwa dikhaata hai, aur paak o paakeeza hai woh Parwardigar jo aalameen ka paalne waala hai
Moosa! Main woh Khuda hoon jo sab par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Ab tum apne asa ko zameen par daal do. Us ke baad Moosa ne jab dekha to kya dekha ke woh saanp ki tarah lehra raha hai. Moosa ulte paaon palat pade aur mud kar bhi na dekha. Aawaaz aayi ke Moosa! Daro nahin, meri baargaah mein mursaleen nahin dara karte hain
Haan koi shakhs gunaah kar ke phir tauba kar le aur us buraai ko neki se badal de to main bahut bakhshne waala meharbaan hoon

Aur apne haath ko girebaan mein daal kar nikaalo to dekhoge ke baghair kisi beemaari ke safed chamakdaar nikalta hai. Yeh un nau mo'jizaat mein se ek hai jinhein Fir'aun aur us ki qaum ke liye diya gaya hai, ke yeh badi badkaar qaum hai
Magar jab bhi un ke paas waazeh nishaaniyaan aayin to unhon ne keh diya ke yeh khula hua jaadoo hai
Un logon ne zulm aur ghuroor ke jazbe ki bina par inkaar kar diya tha, warna un ke dil ko bilkul yaqeen tha. Phir dekho ke aise mufsideen ka anjaam kya hota hai
Aur hum ne Dawood aur Sulaimaan ko ilm ata kiya to dono ne kaha ke Khuda ka shukr hai ke us ne humein bahut se bandon par fazeelat ata ki hai

Aur phir Sulaimaan Dawood ke waaris hue aur unhon ne kaha ke logo! Mujhe parindon ki baaton ka ilm diya gaya hai aur har fazeelat ka ek hissa ata kiya gaya hai, aur yeh Khuda ka khula hua fazl o karam hai
Aur Sulaimaan ke liye un ka tamaam lashkar, jinnaat, insaan aur parinde sab ikattha kiye jaate the to bilkul murattab munazzam khade kar diye jaate the

Yahaan tak ke jab woh log Waadi-e-Naml tak aaye to ek chyoonti ne aawaaz di ke chyoontiyo! Sab apne apne suraakhon mein daakhil ho jaao ke Sulaimaan aur un ka lashkar tumhein paamaal na kar daale aur inhein us ka sha'oor bhi na ho

Sulaimaan us ki baat par muskura diye aur kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri us ne'mat ka shukriya ada karoon jo tu ne mujhe aur mere waalidain ko ata ki hai, aur aisa nek amal karoon ke tu raazi ho jaaye, aur apni rehmat se mujhe apne nek bandon mein shaamil kar le
Aur Sulaimaan ne Hud-hud ko talaash kiya aur woh nazar na aaya to kaha ke aakhir mujhe kya ho gaya hai ke main Hud-hud ko nahin dekh raha hoon, kya woh ghaaib ho gaya hai
Main use sakht-tareen saza doonga ya phir zibah kar daaloonga, ya yeh ke woh mere paas koi waazeh daleel le aaega
Phir thodi der na guzri thi ke Hud-hud aa gaya aur us ne kaha ke mujhe ek aisi baat maaloom hui hai jo aap ko bhi maaloom nahin hai, aur main mulk-e-Saba se ek yaqeeni khabar le kar aaya hoon
Main ne ek aurat ko dekha hai jo sab par hukoomat kar rahi hai, aur use duniya ki har cheez haasil hai, aur us ke paas bahut bada takht bhi hai

Main ne dekha hai ke woh aur us ki qaum sab sooraj ki pooja kar rahe hain, aur Shaitaan ne un ki nazron mein is amal ko husn bana diya hai aur inhein saheeh raaste se rok diya hai, ke ab woh yeh bhi nahin samajhte hain
Ke kyon na us Khuda ka sajda karein jo aasmaan o zameen ke poshida asraar ko zaahir karne waala hai, aur log jo kuch chhupaate hain ya zaahir karte hain sab ka jaanne waala hai
Woh Allah hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur woh Arsh-e-Azeem ka Parwardigar hai
Sulaimaan ne kaha ke main abhi dekhta hoon ke tu ne sach kaha hai ya tera shumaar bhi jhooton mein hai
Yeh mera khat le kar ja aur un logon ke saamne daal de, phir un ke paas se hat ja aur yeh dekh ke woh kya jawaab dete hain
Us aurat ne kaha ke mere zu'ama-e-saltanat! Meri taraf ek bada mohtaram khat bheja gaya hai
Jo Sulaimaan ki taraf se hai aur us ka mazmoon yeh hai ke shuroo karta hoon Khuda ke naam se jo bada Rehmaan o Raheem hai
Dekho mere muqaable mein sarkashi na karo aur itaa'at-guzaar ban kar chale aao
Zu'ama-e-mamlakat! Mere mas'ale mein raaye do, ke main tumhaari raaye ke baghair koi hatmi faisla nahin kar sakti
Un logon ne kaha ke hum saahibaan-e-quwwat aur maahireen-e-jang o jidaal hain, aur ikhtiyaar bahar-haal aap ke haath mein hai, aap bataayein ke aap ka hukm kya hai
Us ne kaha ke baadshaah jab kisi ilaaqe mein daakhil hote hain to basti ko weeraan kar dete hain aur saahibaan-e-izzat ko zaleel kar dete hain, aur un ka yahi tareeqa-e-kaar hota hai
Aur main un ki taraf ek hadiya bhej rahi hoon, aur phir dekh rahi hoon ke mere numaainde kya jawaab le kar aate hain

Us ke baad jab qaasid Sulaimaan ke paas aaya to unhon ne kaha ke tum apne maal se meri imdaad karna chaahte ho, jab ke jo kuch Khuda ne mujhe diya hai woh tumhaare maal se kahin zyaada behtar hai. Jaao tum khud hi apne hadiye se khush raho
Jaao tum waapas jaao, ab main ek aisa lashkar le kar aaoonga jis ka muqaabla mumkin na hoga, aur phir sab ko zillat o ruswaai ke saath mulk se baahar nikaaloonga
Phir e'laan kiya ke mere ashraaf-e-saltanat! Tum mein kaun hai jo us ke takht ko le kar aaye qabl is ke ke woh log itaa'at-guzaar ban kar haazir hon
To jinnaat mein se ek dev ne kaha ke main itni jaldi le aaoonga ke aap apni jagah se bhi na uthenge, main bada saahib-e-quwwat aur zimmedaar hoon

Aur ek shakhs ne jis ke paas kitaab ka ek hissa ilm tha us ne kaha ke main itni jaldi le aaoonga ke aap ki palak bhi na jhapakne paaye. Us ke baad Sulaimaan ne takht ko apne saamne haazir dekha to kehne lage ke yeh mere Parwardigar ka fazl o karam hai, woh mera imtehaan lena chaahta hai ke main shukriya ada karta hoon ya kufraan-e-ne'mat karta hoon, aur jo shukriya ada karega woh apne hi faaide ke liye karega, aur jo kufraan-e-ne'mat karega us ki taraf se mera Parwardigar be-niyaaz aur Kareem hai
Sulaimaan ne kaha ke us ke takht ko naa-qaabil-e-shanaakht bana diya jaaye taake hum dekhein ke woh samajh paati hai ya na-samajh logon mein hai

Jab woh aayi to Sulaimaan ne kaha ke kya tumhaara takht aisa hi hai? Us ne kaha ke bilkul aisa hi hai, balke shaayad yahi hai, aur mujhe to pehle hi ilm ho gaya tha aur main itaa'at-guzaar ho gayi thi
Aur use us ma'bood ne rok rakha tha jise Khuda ko chhod kar ma'bood banaaye hue thi, ke woh ek kaafir qaum se ta'alluq rakhti thi

Phir us se kaha gaya ke qasr mein daakhil ho jaaye. Ab jo us ne dekha to samjhi ke koi gehra paani hai aur apni pindliyaan khol deen. Sulaimaan ne kaha ke yeh ek qila hai jise sheeshon se mandh diya gaya hai. Aur Bilqees ne kaha ke main ne apne nafs par zulm kiya tha aur ab main Sulaimaan ke saath us Khuda par imaan le aayi hoon jo aalameen ka paalne waala hai
Aur hum ne qaum-e-Samood ki taraf un ke bhai Saaleh ko bheja ke tum log Allah ki ibaadat karo, to dono fareeq aapas mein jhagda karne lage
Saaleh ne kaha ke qaum waalo! Aakhir bhalaai se pehle buraai ki jaldi kyon kar rahe ho? Tum log Allah se istighfaar kyon nahin karte ke shaayad tum par rahm kar diya jaaye

Un logon ne kaha ke hum ne tum se aur tumhaare saathiyon se bura shagun hi paaya hai. Unhon ne kaha ke tumhaari badqismati Allah ke paas muqaddar hai, aur yeh dar-haqeeqat tumhaari aazmaaish ki ja rahi hai
Aur us shehar mein nau afraad the jo zameen mein fasaad barpa karte the aur islaah nahin karte the

Un logon ne kaha ke tum sab aapas mein Khuda ki qasam khaao ke Saaleh aur un ke ghar waalon par raaton raat hamla kar doge, aur baad mein un ke waarison se keh doge ke hum un ke ghar waalon ki halaakat ke waqt maujood hi nahin the, aur hum apne bayaan mein bilkul sachche hain
Aur phir unhon ne apni chaal chali aur hum ne bhi apna intezaam kiya ke inhein khabar bhi na ho saki
Phir ab dekho ke un ki makkaari ka anjaam kya hua, ke hum ne un ru'asa ko un ki qaum samet bilkul tabaah o barbaad kar diya
Ab yeh un ke ghar hain jo zulm ki bina par khaali pade hue hain, aur yaqeenan is mein saahibaan-e-ilm ke liye ek nishaani paayi jaati hai
Aur hum ne un logon ko najaat de di jo imaan waale the aur taqwa-e-Ilaahi ikhtiyaar kiye hue the
Aur Loot ko yaad karo jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha ke kya tum aankhein rakhte hue badkaari ka irtikaab kar rahe ho
Kya tum log az-raah-e-shahwat mardon se ta'alluqaat paida kar rahe ho aur auraton ko chhode de rahe ho? Aur dar-haqeeqat tum log bilkul jaahil qaum ho
To un ki qaum ka koi jawaab nahin tha siwaaye is ke ke Loot waalon ko apni basti se nikaal baahar kar do, ke yeh log bahut paakbaaz ban rahe hain
To hum ne Loot aur un ke khaandaan waalon ko, zauja ke ilaawa, sab ko najaat de di, ke woh peechhe reh jaane waalon mein thi
Aur hum ne un par ajeeb o ghareeb qism ki baarish kar di, ke jin logon ko daraaya jaata hai un par baarish-e-azaab bhi bahut buri hoti hai
Aap kahiye: saari taareef Allah ke liye hai, aur salaam hai us ke un bandon par jinhein us ne muntakhab kar liya hai. Aaya Khuda zyaada behtar hai ya jinhein yeh shareek bana rahe hain

Bhala woh kaun hai jis ne aasmaan o zameen ko paida kiya hai aur tumhaare liye aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai, phir hum ne us se khushnuma baagh ugaaye hain ke tum un ke darakhton ko nahin uga sakte the? Kya Khuda ke saath koi aur khuda hai? Nahin, balke yeh log khud apni taraf se doosron ko Khuda ke baraabar bana rahe hain

Bhala woh kaun hai jis ne zameen ko qaraar ki jagah banaaya, aur phir us ke darmiyaan nahrein jaari keen, aur us ke liye pahaad banaaye, aur do daryaaon ke darmiyaan hadd-e-faasil qaraar di? Kya Khuda ke saath koi aur bhi khuda hai? Hargiz nahin, asl yeh hai ke un ki aksariyat jaahil hai

Bhala woh kaun hai jo muztar ki faryaad ko sunta hai jab woh us ko aawaaz deta hai, aur us ki museebat ko door kar deta hai, aur tum logon ko zameen ka waaris banaata hai? Kya Khuda ke saath koi aur khuda hai? Nahin, balke yeh log bahut kam naseehat haasil karte hain

Bhala woh kaun hai jo khushki aur tari ki taareekiyon mein tumhaari rehnumaai karta hai, aur baarish se pehle bashaarat ke taur par hawaayein chalaata hai? Kya Allah ke saath koi aur khuda hai? Yaqeenan woh Khuda tamaam makhlooqaat se kahin zyaada buland o baala hai jinhein yeh log us ka shareek bana rahe hain

Ya kaun hai jo khalq ki ibtida karta hai aur phir dobaara bhi wahi paida karega, aur kaun hai jo aasmaan aur zameen se rizq ata karta hai? Kya Khuda ke saath koi aur bhi ma'bood hai? Aap keh dijiye ke agar tum apne da'we mein sachche ho to apni daleel le aao
Keh dijiye ke aasmaan o zameen mein ghaib ka jaanne waala Allah ke ilaawa koi nahin hai, aur yeh log nahin jaante hain ke inhein kab dobaara uthaaya jaaega
Balke aakhirat ke baare mein un ka ilm naaqis reh gaya hai, balke yeh us ki taraf se shak mein mubtala hain, balke yeh bilkul andhe hain
Aur kuffaar yeh kehte hain ke kya jab hum aur hamaare baap daada sab mitti ho jaayenge to phir dobaara nikaale jaayenge
Aisa waada hum se aur hamaare baap daada se bahut pehle se kiya ja raha hai, aur yeh sab agle logon ki kahaaniyaan hain aur bas
Aap un se keh dijiye ke roo-e-zameen mein sair karo aur phir dekho ke mujrimeen ka anjaam kaisa hua hai
Aur aap un ke haal par ranjeeda na hon, aur yeh jo chaalein chal rahe hain un ki taraf se bhi dil-tang na hon
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke agar tum sachche ho to yeh waada aakhir kab poora hone waala hai
To keh dijiye ke bahut mumkin hai ke jis azaab ki tum jaldi kar rahe ho us ka koi hissa tumhaare peechhe hi laga hua ho
Aur aap ka Parwardigar bandon ke haq mein bahut zyaada meharbaan hai, lekin un ki aksariyat shukriya nahin ada karti hai
Aur aap ka Parwardigar woh sab jaanta hai jise un ke dil chhupaaye hue hain ya jis ka yeh e'laan kar rahe hain
Aur aasmaan o zameen mein koi poshida cheez aisi nahin hai jis ka zikr Kitaab-e-Mubeen mein na ho
Beshak yeh Quran Bani Israaeel ke saamne un bahut si baaton ki hikaayat karta hai jin ke baare mein woh aapas mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe hain
Aur yeh Quran saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye hidaayat aur rehmat hai
Aap ka Parwardigar un ke darmiyaan apne hukm se faisla karta hai, aur woh sab par ghaalib bhi hai aur sab se baakhabar bhi hai
Lihaaza aap usi par e'timaad karein ke aap waazeh haq ke raaste par hain
Aap murdon ko aur behron ko apni aawaaz nahin suna sakte agar woh munh pher kar bhaag khade hon
Aur aap andhon ko bhi un ki gumraahi se raah-e-raast par nahin la sakte hain. Aap apni aawaaz sirf un logon ko suna sakte hain jo hamaari aayaton par imaan rakhte hain aur hamaare itaa'at-guzaar hain
Aur jab un par waada poora hoga to hum zameen se ek chalne waala nikaal kar khada kar denge jo un se yeh baat kare ke kaun log hamaari aayaat par yaqeen nahin rakhte the
Aur us din hum har ummat mein se woh fauj ikattha karenge jo hamaari aayaton ki takzeeb kiya karte the, aur phir alag alag taqseem kar diye jaayenge
Yahaan tak ke jab sab aa jaayenge to irshaad-e-Ahadiyyat hoga ke kya tum logon ne meri aayaton ki takzeeb ki thi haalaanke tumhein un ka mukammal ilm nahin tha, ya tum kya kar rahe the
Aur un ke zulm ki bina par un par baat saabit ho jaaegi aur woh bolne ke qaabil bhi na honge
Kya un logon ne nahin dekha ke hum ne raat ko paida kiya taake yeh sukoon haasil kar sakein, aur din ko raushni ka zariya banaaya? Is mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye hamaari badi nishaaniyaan hain
Aur jis din Soor phoonka jaaega to zameen o aasmaan mein jo bhi hai sab larz jaayenge ilaawa un ke jin ko Khuda chaahe, aur sab us ki baargaah mein sar jhukaaye haazir honge

Aur tum dekhoge to samjhoge ke jaise pahaad apni jagah par jaamid hain, haalaanke yeh baadalon ki tarah chal rahe honge. Yeh us Khuda ki san'at hai jis ne har cheez ko muhkam banaaya hai, aur woh tumhaare tamaam aamaal se baakhabar hai
Jo koi neki karega use us se behtar ajr milega, aur woh log roz-e-qiyaamat ke khauf se mahfooz bhi rahenge
Aur jo log buraai karenge inhein munh ke bal Jahannam mein dhakel diya jaaega (aur kaha jaaega) ke kya tumhein tumhaare aamaal ke ilaawa bhi koi mu'aawaza diya ja sakta hai

Mujhe to sirf yeh hukm diya gaya hai ke main is shehar ke maalik ki ibaadat karoon jis ne ise mohtaram banaaya hai, aur har shai usi ki milkiyat hai, aur mujhe yeh hukm diya gaya hai ke main itaa'at-guzaaron mein shaamil ho jaaoon
Aur yeh ke main Quran ko padh kar sunaaoon. Ab us ke baad jo hidaayat haasil kar lega woh apne faaide ke liye karega, aur jo behak jaaega us se keh dijiye ke main to sirf daraane waalon mein se hoon
Aur yeh kahiye ke saari hamd sirf Allah ke liye hai, aur woh anqareeb tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhlaaega aur tum pehchaan loge, aur tumhaara Parwardigar tumhaare aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai
